title: 第21章 红豆第22章 露馅了
slug: 重生本统子教宿主当老六
content_zh:
叮，任务完成，奖励已发放！
看着手里的回春丹，陆沉激动的险些叫出声来：“我这就赚了一万灵石了？简直不可思议！”
9527微笑着摇摇头，无奈地说道：“我也没想到会这么快，还想着捡漏来着，不过，或许会有更有意思的事情发生哦！”
说着，露出一抹意味深长的笑容。
看着苟系统那一脸坏笑的样子，陆沉不禁有些胆寒，试着问道：“什么事情？”
苟系统故作高深地回道：“当然是好事咯，走着瞧就好了！”
见苟系统不说，陆沉也就没再多问了。
接下来拍卖的东西就没什么亮点了，不过不少东西陆凯之还是适当地抬价，而这些东西无一例外被吴凡以高价拿下，除了开始那四十瓶赤血散，吴凡前前后后又花了一万多灵石买了一堆没什么用的东西。
“父亲，我们这次出门总共就带了三万灵石，现在已经不足一万了。
后续如果有好东西我们该怎么办？”
吴宣一脸担忧地提醒道。
吴凡一脸无所谓地说道：“后面的东西能拍下来就拍，拍不下来就算了，我们现在的主要目的就是要结交那位炼药师，你先出去多找几个人盯着，待会儿要是有什么与众不同的人从万宝阁出去，就让他们跟上去，待到人少的地方再表明咱们的拉拢之意。
记住，要是看到陆家的人也跟了上去，一定要及时阻止，千万不能让陆家人抢先了。”
吴宣闻言立刻退出包厢，片刻后便得意地回来了：“父亲，都已经安排好了。”
“下面，有请我们的压轴拍品：一本黄阶高级功法《清风诀》，底价一千灵石。”
在小桃的介绍下，现场的众人开始纷纷出价。
“一千五！”
“一千八！”
“两千！”
吴凡财大气粗地给出价格，其他人也没有再加价。

“这吴家还真是财大气粗！
我还想着要不要拍一下呢！”
陆沉咬牙切齿地说道。
“一本黄阶功法有什么好稀罕的？”
9527一脸嫌弃。
“苟系统，你是不是忘了，我到现在都还没有功法和武技呢！
好不容易有本玄阶低级武技的你还不让我练！”
“不是不让你练，是你属实太弱了点，现在的你驾驭不了。
而且功法可是决定了你以后的修炼速度和能达到的高度唉！
你居然想用一本黄阶的随便糊弄一下？”
“那我能怎么办？”
“放心，山人自有妙计，你现在的目标就是先达到一境，到那时才能修行功法。”
陆沉闻言也只能消停下来：“好吧，就听你的吧。”
“下面，让我们请出今天的最后一件拍品。”
小桃甜美的声音传来，一位身穿旗袍的女子端着一个托盘走上台来，小桃掀开托盘上的红布，映入眼帘的是一颗红色的豆子。
地下的人见到后议论纷纷：“这是做什么？拿一颗豆子当宝贝卖？”
小桃连忙解释：“这是一颗神秘的种子，由一个冒险队偶然获得，坚硬如铁，火烧不坏，虽然不知道是什么植物的种子，但绝非一般的东西。
底价两千灵石。”
虽然没人认识，但还是有人出价：“我出两千一！”
“两千二！”

这次的加价幅度都不是很大，大部分人都是奔着试试看的心态去出价的。
“苟系统，你说他们是不是疯了，就一颗红豆就能卖两千多？”
陆沉小声吐槽道，然而苟系统却没回答他，陆沉转头望去，只见苟系统正一脸不可思议地看着那枚红豆。
content_en:
Ding, the mission is completed and the rewards have been distributed!
Looking at the Rejuvenation Pill in his hand, Lu Chen was so excited that he almost shouted: "I've earned ten thousand spirit stones now? It's incredible!"
9527 smiled and shook his head, and said helplessly: "I didn't expect it to be so fast. I was still thinking about picking up the leaks, but maybe something more interesting will happen!"
As he spoke, he showed a meaningful smile.
Seeing the evil smile on Gou System's face, Lu Chen couldn't help but feel a little scared and tried to ask: "What's going on?"
System Gou replied in a pretentious manner: "Of course it's a good thing, just wait and see!"
Seeing that Gou didn't say anything, Lu Chen didn't ask any more questions.
The items that were auctioned next had no highlights, but Lu Kaizhi still raised the price appropriately for many items, and without exception, these items were bought by Wu Fan at a high price. Except for the first forty bottles of red blood powder, Wu Fan spent more than 10,000 spiritual stones to buy a bunch of useless items.
"Father, we brought a total of 30,000 spiritual stones when we went out this time, and now we have less than 10,000.
What should we do if there is something good in the future? "
Wu Xuan reminded with a worried look.
Wu Fan said nonchalantly: "If you can take a picture of the things behind, forget it if you can't. Our main purpose now is to make friends with the alchemist. You go out first and find a few more people to keep an eye on. If there is anyone out of the ordinary coming out of Wanbao Pavilion later, let them follow them. We will show our intention to win over him when there are few people."
Remember, if you see someone from the Lu family following you, you must stop them in time, and you must not let the Lu family get there first. "
Wu Xuan immediately exited the box after hearing this, and returned proudly after a moment: "Father, everything has been arranged."
"Now, here's our grand finale: a copy of the Huang-level advanced technique "Qingfeng Jue", with a base price of one thousand spirit stones."
Under Xiao Tao's introduction, everyone at the scene began to place bids.
"One thousand and five!"
"One thousand and eighty!"
"Two thousand!"
Wu Fancai gave the price generously, and no one else raised the price.
“The Wu family is really wealthy!
I was still thinking about taking a photo! "
Lu Chen gritted his teeth and said.
"What's so rare about a yellow-level skill?"
9527 looked disgusted.
"Gou System, have you forgotten that I don't have any martial arts or martial arts skills yet!
I finally have low-level martial arts at this level and you still don’t let me practice them! "
"It's not that I don't let you practice, it's that you are too weak and you can't control it now.
Moreover, the exercises determine the speed of your future cultivation and the height you can reach!
You actually want to use a yellow-level book to fool you? "
"Then what can I do?"
"Don't worry, the mountain man has his own clever plan. Your goal now is to reach the first level first, and then you can practice the technique."
Lu Chen could only stop after hearing this: "Okay, I'll just listen to you."
"Now, let's bring out the last item for today."
Xiao Tao's sweet voice came, and a woman wearing a cheongsam came onto the stage carrying a tray. Xiao Tao opened the red cloth on the tray, and what came into view was a red bean.
When people in the underground saw it, they started talking about it: "What are you doing? Selling a bean as a treasure?"
Xiao Tao quickly explained: "This is a mysterious seed, accidentally obtained by an adventure team. It is as hard as iron and cannot be burned by fire. Although I don't know what kind of plant seed it is, it is definitely not an ordinary thing.
The base price is two thousand spirit stones. "
Although no one knew him, someone still made an offer: "I'll pay two thousand one!"
"Two thousand two!"
The price increase this time is not very large, and most people bid with the mentality of giving it a try.
"Gou System, do you think they are crazy? Just one red bean can sell for more than two thousand?"
Lu Chen complained in a low voice, but the Gou system did not answer him. Lu ChenShen turned around and saw Gou System looking at the red bean in disbelief.
